extracted.name: Pico de Gallo
extracted.description: This homemade Pico de Gallo recipe only takes 10 minutes and is made with fresh tomatoes, cilantro, red onion, and jalapeño. It is bursting with fresh flavors and instantly elevates any dish, or can be enjoyed with chips.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup white or red onion (, diced)
1 small jalepeño pepper (, veins and seeds removed, diced)
instruction_lines: Combine diced tomatoes, onion, cilantro and jalapeño in a bowl. Season with salt and add lime juice to taste.
Top on your favorite Mexican food, eggs, avocado toast, chicken, or serve with chips.
categories: how to make pico de gallo
